_comment: Offboarding a person (S2-50). Design: documents/security/offboarding-and-retention-design-2026-11-20.md. Read by utils/offboarding.js and scripts/reconcile_offboarding.js.

stewards._comment: Who receives the content of a person whose account is gone, per organization (D2). 'platform_org' means the platform organization (env TENANT_ID) and resolves to the platform owner (env OWNER_USER_ID). Other organizations: '<org id>': '<Clerk user id of the steward>'. An organization with no steward keeps the content where it is (counted as awaiting_steward) until one is set.

sweep._comment: The orphan sweep refuses to change anything when more people than this look deleted (likely a Clerk outage or the wrong Clerk instance); rerun with --force after checking. Before acting it confirms the platform owner exists in this Clerk instance.
